premise: To see a faint faraway galaxy in the long night, Leo and Maya drive the buggy out beyond the base's lights and wait in the dark until it glows.
inspiration: Andersen's 'The Nightingale', where the real bird outshines the jewelled one, turned: the real sky outshines every lamp, once you leave the lamps behind.
lesson: Sometimes you see more when you turn the lights down.

en-US.title: Lights Off for the Galaxy
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall} Deep in the long Moon night, {woman:enter} Maya and {man:enter} Leo had a plan: stargazing. But the lamps around the base were so bright that the sky looked dull and grey. {man:face sad} So out across the plain went the {buggy:enter} buggy, {buggy:go to crater} {man:go to crater} {woman:go to crater} all the way to the crater's edge, far from the lights. [whispers] They lay back and let their eyes get used to the dark. {woman:pulse} {canvas:milkyway} Slowly, more stars came out. Then more. Then the pale river of the Milky Way. {woman:face surprised} And high over the ridge glowed a soft little swirl: a whole {galaxy:enter} {galaxy:float loop 0.2} galaxy. {galaxy:live hold} It glowed, faint and far, made of more stars than anyone could count. {woman:says} [in awe] “You can only see it in the dark.” {man:face happy} {man:says} [whispers] “That's the dark, helping.” They watched until their toes got chilly. {woman:tint #9AD0FF} {man:live} Then Leo checked his wrist: bedtime. [softly] {buggy:pulse} All the way home, nobody said a word. {woman:face happy} They didn't need to.

es-ES.title: Luces fuera para ver la galaxia
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall} En plena noche lunar, {woman:enter} Maya y {man:enter} Leo tenían un plan: mirar las estrellas. Pero las lámparas de la base brillaban tanto que el cielo parecía apagado y gris. {man:face sad} Así que el {buggy:enter} buggy cruzó la llanura {buggy:go to crater} {man:go to crater} {woman:go to crater} hasta el borde del cráter, lejos de las luces. [whispers] Se tumbaron y dejaron que sus ojos se acostumbraran a la oscuridad. {woman:pulse} {canvas:milkyway} Poco a poco salieron más estrellas. Y más. Y luego el río pálido de la Vía Láctea. {woman:face surprised} Y sobre las montañas brillaba un remolino suave: toda una {galaxy:enter} {galaxy:float loop 0.2} galaxia. {galaxy:live hold} Brillaba, débil y lejana, hecha de más estrellas de las que nadie podría contar. {woman:says} [in awe] «Solo se ve en la oscuridad.» {man:face happy} {man:says} [whispers] «Es la oscuridad, que ayuda.» Miraron hasta que se les enfriaron los pies. {woman:tint #9AD0FF} {man:live} Luego Leo miró su muñeca: a dormir. [softly] {buggy:pulse} En todo el camino de vuelta, nadie dijo nada. {woman:face happy} No hacía falta.
